Title: Monthly Motor Lubrication & Thermal Audit
Checklist_SOP: 1. Lock out motor breaker. 2. Clean grease zerk. 3. Apply 2 pumps Mobil Polyrex EM. 4. Check bearing temp with infrared gun. 5. Clear LOTO.

Title: Quarterly Air Filter & Belt Tension Audit
Checklist_SOP: 1. Isolate disconnect switch. 2. Replace MERV 13 pleated filters. 3. Check V-belt deflection (0.5 inch). 4. Record static pressure drop.

Title: 500-Hour Compressor Oil Sampling & Filter Check
Checklist_SOP: 1. Draw oil sample from active port. 2. Check differential pressure on separator element. 3. Clean radiator core with compressed air.

Title: Semi-Annual Gearbox Oil Level & Backlash Inspection
Checklist_SOP: 1. De-energize and LOTO. 2. Check synthetic oil level at sight glass. 3. Inspect magnetic drain plug for metal shavings. 4. Verify coupling alignment.

Title: Annual Electrical Enclosure Cleaning & Thermal Scan
Checklist_SOP: 1. LOTO main feed. 2. Vacuum enclosure cooling fans. 3. Inspect terminal lugs with calibrated torque screwdriver. 4. Thermal camera scan under full load.
